e.title: stressed-insurance-datasets
e.summary: 保险 ML/LLM 鲁棒性压测工具包（Vaynork）：输入冲击（噪声/缺失/格式/矛盾）→ 度量模型退化
e.body: stressed-insurance-datasets 是 Vaynork 的鲁棒性压测工具包（CI 完备，Python 3.10+）：对保险 ML/LLM 系统应用文档化的输入冲击（噪声、缺失、格式变化、矛盾信息），度量模型性能退化程度——模型鲁棒性测试（输入质量敏感的精算/承保模型必须验证）。对 RIAA：保险模型风险管理的鲁棒性测试范式。与 [[insurance-governance]]（模型治理）、[[acteval]]（模型评估）、[[insurance-monitoring]]（漂移监控）互补。关联 [[machine-learning-pricing]]、[[actuarial-pricing]]。

e.summary_en: Robustness-stress toolkit for insurance ML/LLM systems (Vaynork): apply input shocks (noise/missingness/formatting/contradictions) and measure model degradation
e.summary_hk: 保險 ML/LLM 魯棒性壓測工具包（Vaynork）：輸入衝擊（噪聲/缺失/格式/矛盾）→ 度量模型退化
e.body_en: stressed-insurance-datasets is Vaynork's robustness-stress toolkit (CI-complete, Python 3.10+): apply documented input shocks (noise, missingness, formatting changes, contradictory information) to insurance ML/LLM systems and measure how far performance degrades — robustness testing that input-quality-sensitive actuarial/underwriting models must undergo. For RIAA: the robustness-testing pattern for insurance model-risk management. Complements [[insurance-governance]] (model governance), [[acteval]] (model evaluation) and [[insurance-monitoring]] (drift monitoring). Related: [[machine-learning-pricing]], [[actuarial-pricing]].
e.body_hk: stressed-insurance-datasets 是 Vaynork 的魯棒性壓測工具包（CI 完備，Python 3.10+）：對保險 ML/LLM 系統應用文檔化的輸入衝擊（噪聲、缺失、格式變化、矛盾信息），度量模型性能退化程度——模型魯棒性測試（輸入質量敏感的精算/承保模型必須驗證）。對 RIAA：保險模型風險管理的魯棒性測試範式。與 [[insurance-governance]]（模型治理）、[[acteval]]（模型評估）、[[insurance-monitoring]]（漂移監控）互補。關聯 [[machine-learning-pricing]]、[[actuarial-pricing]]。
